# Cintia Henriksson — Senior Product Manager

> Portfolio of Cintia Henriksson, a Senior Product Manager with 8+ years in fintech and telecom. She ships governed AI systems and multi-platform products from MVP to production, with a focus on reducing churn, deflecting support load, and delivering safe AI. She also holds a formal background in photography and visual arts, and is a certified meditation teacher.

The site is bilingual (English and Spanish) and covers her product leadership, three in-depth AI case studies, and her creative and contemplative practice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ai-pm-portfolio.vercel.app/): Overview, positioning, an outcome scorecard, and an index of case studies.
- [About](https://ai-pm-portfolio.vercel.app/about): Career history, skills, education, languages, meditation teaching credentials, and links to external profiles.

## Case studies

- [Remesas Discovery](https://ai-pm-portfolio.vercel.app/cases/remesas-discovery): Product discovery for a cross-border remittances flow.
- [Agente de Pagos](https://ai-pm-portfolio.vercel.app/cases/agente-pagos): A governed payments AI agent with release gates and safety controls, including an interactive agent simulator.
- [Alumnas Roadmap](https://ai-pm-portfolio.vercel.app/cases/alumnas-roadmap): Roadmap prioritization work, including an interactive RICE calculator.
